metadata.description: Public Claude Code toolkit for the Minder ecosystem — the plugin-authoring toolkit plus a generic autonomous development operator (MinderHQ is its reference integration).

plugins.name: minder-authoring
plugins.description: Community toolkit for authoring Minder product plugins against the public plugin-sdk / plugin-template (scaffold, SDK-contract validation, protocol + security review), plus the MinderHQ dev-operator policy — the minderhq specialisation of the generic `dev` operator (entrypoint /minder-dev-queue).

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Generic, organization-agnostic autonomous development operator: work a GitHub issue backlog end-to-end (select → implement → test → review → commit → push → PR → verify → resume) via /dev:develop, /dev:resume, /dev:status. Specialised per project by a lightweight dev-policy; reusable for any repo/org.
